## Change

Describe the player-facing or operational change and its reason.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check` and relevant browser flows passed, or failures are explained.
- [ ] Affected plan, requirements, architecture, rights, privacy, security, quality, and operations files were updated under `AGENTS.md`.
- [ ] New assets have entries in `ASSET_REGISTER.md` and appropriate credits.

## Release to `main` (if applicable)

- [ ] Production rights, privacy/contact, accessibility, security, and device checks have recorded evidence.
- [ ] Vercel preview was tested and the production rollback target is known.
- [ ] Neeraj Saini approved the public release.
